target: The project state JSON path (from app_state.document_path) or audacity_project
description: Manipulates a deterministic Audacity timeline snapshot stored as JSON. Actions should only describe visible timeline outcomes such as track names, mute or solo state, selection bounds, labels, clip timing, transport state, and export settings.

actions.name: set_track_value
actions.description: Update a visible track property like name, mute, solo, gain_db, pan, or height_px.

examples.description: Rename the music track and unmute it
Add a new CTA FX track and move it to the top of the stack

actions.name: set_selection_or_labels
actions.description: Adjust the visible timeline selection or edit labels shown on the label track.

actions.name: set_clip_transport_export
actions.description: Update visible clip timing, transport state, or export settings.

examples.description: Trim the voice clip and switch export format to MP3

done_action.description: Return this action when the task is fully complete.

tips: Use exact track ids from the observation, such as track:track_music implying track_id=track_music
When tasks add or remove tracks, prefer add_track, delete_track, and move_track instead of overloading label or clip operations.
Keep actions focused on GUI-visible outcomes instead of hidden internal metadata
Selection bounds are measured in seconds and should match the visible timeline range
Labels should include visible text plus start and end times
Export settings should update both format and filename when the task asks for a different output artifact
Set target to the exact project path shown in app_state.document_path or use audacity_project when the adapter allows it
